{{Vanilla}}

{{Infobox auto|Melon Slice}}

A '''melon''' is a block whose slices are a raw [[ingredient]] with the [[intrinsic]] {{EffectLink|Fire Resistance}}. A '''melon slice''' eaten raw heals {{Hp|1}}.<ref>{{Source|MF_datapack/data/matcha/loot_table/food/melon_slice.json}}</ref> Cooked and prepared, it grants Fire Resistance for up to 10 minutes, which the developer suggests taking before a trip to [[Hell]].<ref>{{Cite video|quote=If they're planning a trip to hell, they'll want to find some melons first.}}</ref>

== Obtaining ==

=== Breaking ===
A melon block drops the pack's melon slices, or itself with Silk Touch.<ref>{{Source|MF_datapack/data/minecraft/loot_table/blocks/melon.json}}</ref>

=== Crafting ===
{{Recipes|Melon Slice}}
A melon block can be crafted back into 9 slices.

{{Sources|Melon Slice}}

== Usage ==

=== Food ===
Eating a melon slice heals {{Hp|1}}.

Picking up a melon or a melon slice unlocks [[grilled melon]] (0:10), [[rind jam]] (5:00) and [[melon sorbet]] (10:00), the three Fire Resistance foods.

{{Uses|Melon Slice}}

== Behavior ==
Endermen can only pick up melons, pumpkins and TNT.
